quote: Zero-shot Text-to-Speech (TTS) models represent a milestone in speech synthesis, enabling the generation of high-quality speech for previously unseen speakers without additional fine-tuning.

Our work investigates whether an off-the-shelf text-to-speech (TTS) model can be trained with limited real transcribed speech data-just tens of hours-to generate synthetic data that enhances multilingual ASR models.
